models.name: Abliterated Large Flash
models.description: Abliterated Large Flash is an uncensored reasoning model based on DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017. Its shared input/output context is 1,048,576 tokens, with up to 262,144 output tokens when space permits. Reasoning defaults to high and can be turned off or set to low, high, or max. Supports up to four images across the request history.

models.name: Ousia 1
models.description: Ousia 1 is a web research model from Hyperresearch: it searches the web for your question and answers with numbered citations and a list of its sources. Answers usually take 30 to 70 seconds and arrive all at once, and harder questions can take several minutes. It follows the answer language and length set in a system message, but not formatting instructions. Leave the output limit unset or at least 15,000 tokens: a smaller limit cuts the research short. Text only, with no tool calling. Ousia 1 searches the web for you: searches based on your question are sent to search providers, some of which may use them to improve their services. Not zero-retention.

It is optimized for the most demanding workloads, including complex multi-step agents, long-context analysis, and high-accuracy reasoning over code, math, and science. The model employs a hybrid Latent Mixture-of-Experts (LatentMoE) architecture, utilizing interleaved Mamba-2 and MoE layers, along with select Attention layers. Like the Super model, the Ultra model incorporates Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) layers for faster text generation and improved quality, and it is trained using an NVFP4 pre-training recipe to maximize compute efficiency. The model has 55B active parameters and 550B parameters in total.
